routing.student: /dashboard - Overview, Results, Routine, Notices, Profile (Role restricted)
routing.admin: /admin - Full Management: Notices, Students, Teachers, Results, Site-Content (Role restricted)

frontend_structure.lib: api.ts (fetch wrapper), auth.ts (client auth), session.ts (server auth)

architectural_notes: Separated Dashboard (student) and Admin Panel. Admin routes under /admin use a dark-themed layout. Auth guards implemented in layout.tsx files using getSession(). Frontend communicates with FastAPI backend via proxy.ts/api.ts.
